chunks: Ali, from his father, from Ibn Abi ʿUmayr, from Hammad, from al-Halabi, who said:
I asked Aba ʿAbdillah عليه السلام about ambergris and diving for pearls, so he عليه السلام said: “Khums is due upon it.”

key_terms.الْخُمُسُ: the one-fifth tax legally due on certain forms of wealth
key_terms.الْعَنْبَرِ: ambergris, a valuable substance taken from the sea
key_terms.غَوْصِ: diving, specifically submerging to extract valuables

ai.seo_question: Is khums obligatory on ambergris and pearls obtained by diving?
ai.summary: This hadith states that khums is obligatory on ambergris and on what is obtained through diving for pearls. It is a concise legal ruling concerning forms of wealth extraction from the sea and their liability to khums.

en.hubeali: Ali, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hammad, from Al Halby who said,
‘I asked Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> about the ambergris and diving for pearls, so he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Upon it is the Khums (fifth)’.
en.sarwar: 28. Ali has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayar from Hammad from al-Halabi who has said the following.
“I asked abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) about the corral and diving for pearls. The Imam (a.s.) said, “There is al-Khums due on them.”
